JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION A:
Michael Meyer
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0105 | michael.meyer@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Claims data analyst with eleven years of reporting and analysis work, the last eight at a property and casualty insurer. Produces the severity trend reporting that claims leadership uses to plan reserves and staffing, and took part in a team move from SAS to Python. Interested in bringing the same care to questions about price, promotion and inventory in retail.

EXPERIENCE
Claims Reporting Analyst | Sorrelwood Mutual Insurance, Columbus, OH | Mar 2022 to Present
• Prepare the monthly severity trend package for auto physical damage, bodily injury and homeowners lines, reviewed by claims directors and actuarial partners.
• Converted five of the team's scheduled SAS programs to Python and SQL during a migration led by the reporting manager, comparing old and new outputs by hand before cutover.
• Keep Tableau dashboards for adjuster caseload and cycle time current across five regional claims offices.
• Pulled cycle time data for a pilot that routed low severity glass claims to a virtual adjusting team and produced the comparison charts for the claims director.
• Investigate unexpected swings in paid loss data, usually traced to late coding changes or duplicate payment records, and write short explanations for finance.
• Answer weekly questions from claims managers about open inventory, payments and recoveries with SQL against the Snowflake warehouse.
• Built a monthly subrogation recovery summary by region for the recovery unit manager, replacing a manual spreadsheet roll-up.
• Keep run documentation for the scheduled reports current so the on-call analyst can rerun a failed job.

Claims Data Analyst | Sorrelwood Mutual Insurance, Columbus, OH | Nov 2018 to Feb 2022
• Wrote SQL against the claims data warehouse (Teradata, later moved to Snowflake) for weekly reporting on open claims and payments.
• Produced catastrophe reports after major hail and wind events, matching claim counts to policy exposure.
• Maintained a SAS model that flagged claims likely to exceed initial reserve, used by supervisors in weekly file reviews.
• Answered ad hoc requests from claims supervisors on adjuster workload and pending file counts, typically within two days.
• Partnered with IT on a data quality project that corrected loss cause codes on historical claims.

Operations Analyst | Thornbury Benefits Administration, Columbus, OH | Aug 2015 to Oct 2018
• Built daily call center and enrollment volume reports in Excel and Access for a benefits processing team of 70.
• Wrote first SQL queries against the enrollment database to reconcile carrier eligibility files.
• Forecast seasonal staffing for open enrollment from three years of historical volume.
• Cleaned and merged duplicate member records ahead of a system conversion.
• Tracked processing backlogs by client and sent a weekly status summary to account managers.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2015

SKILLS
Programming: SQL (Snowflake, Teradata), Python (pandas), SAS (Base, Enterprise Guide)
BI and reporting: Tableau Desktop and Server, Excel (Power Pivot, advanced formulas)
Methods: trend analysis, pilot comparison charts, data validation, reserve monitoring
Workflow: Git, Airflow job monitoring, technical documentation

ADDITIONAL
• Tableau Desktop Specialist certification, 2020
• Volunteer database cleanup for a local historical society's archive catalog
